item.title: Context7 MCP server - issue when adding it!

comments.body: when trying to add : ```json { "mcpServers": { "context7": { "command": "bunx", "args": ["-y", "@upstash/context7-mcp@1.0.6"] } } } ``` I got from error logs : ```js [ERROR] 2025-10-14 11:05:20,547 - :140 - Connection timed out for server `context7`. Config was: {"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/inspector"]} Traceback (most recent call last): File "/Users/abdelhameed/.codegeex/mamba/envs/codegeex-agent/lib/python3.11/site-packages/anyio/streams/memory.py", line 111, in receive return self.receive_nowait() ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/Users/abdelhameed/.codegeex/mamba/envs/codegeex-agent/lib/python3.11/site-packages/anyio/streams/memory.py", line 106, in receive_nowait raise WouldBlock anyio.WouldBlock During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred: Traceback (most recent call last): File "", line 42, in connect File "/Users/abdelhameed/.codegeex/mamba/envs/codegeex-agent/lib/python3.11/site-packages/mcp/client/session.py", line 151, in initialize result = await self.send_request( ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/Users/abdelhameed/.codegeex/mamba/envs/codegeex-agent/lib/python3.11/site-packages/mcp/shared/session.py", line 272, in send_request response_or_error = await response_stream_reader.receive() ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/Users/abdelhameed/.codegeex/mamba/envs/codegeex-agent/lib/python3.11/site-packages/anyio/streams/memory.py", line 119, in receive await receive_event.wait() File "/Users/abdelhameed/.codegeex/mamba/envs/codegeex-agent/lib/python3.11/asyncio/locks.py", line 213, in wait await fut asyncio.exceptions.CancelledError During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred: Traceback (most recent call last): File "", line 121, in _register_server File "", line 37, in connect File "/Users/abdelhameed/.codegeex/mamba/envs/codegeex-agent/lib/python3.11/asyncio/timeouts.py", line 98, in __aexit__ raise TimeoutError TimeoutError [ERROR] 2025-10-14 11:05:39,930 - :146 - Failed to connect or register tools for server `context7`: Connection closed. Config was: {"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/inspector npx @upstash/context7-mcp@latest"]} Traceback (most recent call last): File "", line 121, in _register_server File "", line 42, in connect File "/Users/abdelhameed/.codegeex/mamba/envs/codegeex-agent/lib/python3.11/site-packages/mcp/client/session.py", line 151, in initialize result = await self.send_request( ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/Users/abdelhameed/.codegeex/mamba/envs/codegeex-agent/lib/python3.11/site-packages/mcp/shared/session.py", line 286, in send_request raise McpError(response_or_error.error) mcp.shared.exceptions.McpError: Connection closed [ERROR] 2025-10-14 11:06:01,806 - :140 - Connection timed out for server `context7`. Config was: {"command": "bunx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/inspector"]} Traceback (most recent call last): File "/Users/abdelhameed/.codegeex/mamba/envs/codegeex-agent/lib/python3.11/site-packages/anyio/streams/memory.py", line 111, in receive return self.receive_nowait() ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/Users/abdelhameed/.codegeex/mamba/envs/codegeex-agent/lib/python3.11/site-packages/anyio/streams/memory.py", line 106, in receive_nowait raise WouldBlock anyio.WouldBlock During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred: Traceback (most recent call last): File "", line 42, in connect File "/Users/abdelhameed/.codegeex/mamba/envs/codegeex-agent/lib/python3.11/site-packages/mcp/client/session.py", line 151, in initialize result = await self.send_request( ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/Users/abdelhameed/.codegeex/mamba/envs/codegeex-agent/lib/python3.11/site-packages/mcp/shared/session.py", line 272, in send_request response_or_error = await response_stream_reader.receive() ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/Users/abdelhameed/.codegeex/mamba/envs/codegeex-agent/lib/python3.11/site-packages/anyio/streams/memory.py", line 119, in receive await receive_event.wait() File "/Users/abdelhameed/.codegeex/mamba/envs/codegeex-agent/lib/python3.11/asyncio/locks.py", line 213, in wait await fut asyncio.exceptions.CancelledError During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred: Traceback (most recent call last): File "", line 121, in _register_server File "", line 37, in connect File "/Users/abdelhameed/.codegeex/mamba/envs/codegeex-agent/lib/python3.11/asyncio/timeouts.py", line 98, in __aexit__ raise TimeoutError TimeoutError [ERROR] 2025-10-14 11:06:47,136 - :141 - Error while calling tool resolve_library_id: MCP error -32602: Tool resolve_library_id not found ```
